playstyle: Simple and solid space control. Use homing, safe mids (b+1, b+3, f+3) to lock the opponent down, whiff punish them for moving, and cash in Starburst (STB) for bigger damage and wall splats. His lows are risky or slow, so most of your damage comes from punishing and keep-out.

stances.name: Starburst
stances.entry: Gained on counter-hit df+2, ws2 on hit, and others; always available in Heat
stances.note: A power-up, not a stance you hold: STB versions of moves (4,STB.2, d+1,STB.2, ws1,STB.2) become plus or splat. Wavu: in Heat he can always use Starburst moves.

keyMoves: Burning Core: i13 knee, -4 on block, homing to sidesteps.
Use it a lot: fast, safe and tracking.
Vanishing Storm: i18 homing mid, -8 on block.
Keep-out, homing and wall splat in one (Wavu).
At mid range against people who step or walk in.
The backbone of his space control.
Sacred Edge: i18 homing high, +1 on block.
To keep the turn and catch sidesteps.
Another fast mid (Wavu lists it as a standing mid check).
Sky Slash Nova: i15 launcher, -13 on block.
After -15 moves; the second hit only comes out as a punish or combo.
Sylvia: i15 while-standing launcher, gives STB on hit.
After lows that are -15 or worse.
Holy Smash: i11 while-standing mid, -6 on block.
Chaos Fist: i14 mid, launches on counter hit (+57a) and gives STB.
Blue Moon: i17 high-crushing move, launches on counter hit (+62a).
Crushes highs and launches on CH.
Ira: i13 high, +6 on block, Heat Engager.
A plus-on-block Heat Engager from a run.
To close distance and start Heat.
Roche Limit: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side switch.
Wavu notes his throws are weak: use them as a mix-up only.

combos.name: Launch BnB: f,F+4 b+3 uf+3+4 db+1+2 T! wr2
combos.situation: After a regular launch such as uf+4.
combos.route: f,F+4 b+3 uf+3+4 db+1+2 T! wr2
mistakes: Pressing b+3 before f,F+4 has hit.
Running too late for wr2 after the tornado.
